name: Amber Lord Jumps Over the Wall

description.value:
Mingxi has developed dozens of "creative Xianzhou dishes" for the Upside-Down Restaurant, and "Amber Lord Jumps Over the Wall" has been the most successful of them all. It has already become the go-to dish representing "high-end dining" in Astropolis. Given enough time, it might just come to define the "Astropolis cuisine" entirely.

"Hey boss, why is it called 'Amber Lord Jumps Over the Wall' and not 'Amber Lord Builds the Wall'?"
"'Builds the Wall'? I'm afraid you'd break a tooth trying to chew through that."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. For each affected creature, Strength increases by 1, maximum 20, and critical hits roll one additional weapon or spell damage die. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 24% and CRIT DMG by 24% for the next battle.
